# Acme Employee Handbook

Welcome to Acme. This handbook describes company policies.

## Leave Policy

Employees receive 21 days paid leave annually. Leave accrual begins on the
employee's start date and resets every January 1st. Unused leave may be
carried over up to a maximum of 5 days.

## Office Address

The Acme office is located at 221B Baker Street, London. Office hours are
9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Monday through Friday.

## Remote Work

Employees may work remotely up to three days per week with manager approval.
Equipment requests must be filed through the IT portal.

## Code of Conduct

All employees are expected to act with integrity and respect. Harassment of
any kind is not tolerated and will result in disciplinary action.
